name: Folklore

identity.oneLiner: Handcrafted storybook folk aesthetic: woodland silhouettes, ink contours and natural pigments.
identity.summary: Contemporary folk-inspired storybook design with midnight blue, moss, rust and parchment. Natural silhouettes and hand-cut border rhythms frame content without relying on illustrations for meaning.
identity.authenticityNotes: Never copy specific picture-book characters or artwork. Avoid dense texture behind text and functional controls. Do not confuse storybook folk aesthetics with historically specific Arts and Crafts.

axes.shape: Soft uneven-looking corners on surfaces, stable controls
axes.edge: Fine ink contours and inset botanical rules
axes.ornament: Leaf sprigs, crescent and star details at focal surfaces
axes.typeVoice: Warm readable serif display, humanist body

bands.description: Functional typography and geometry; no decorative illustration.
